newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: SBC Warburg Aust issues NZ$75 mln 2-yr bonds in NZ.
newsitem.headline: SBC Warburg Aust issues NZ$75 mln 2-yr bonds in NZ.

text.p: SBC Warburg Australia said on Thursday it had issued NZ$75 million of 10/98 bonds in the New Zealand market at 43 basis points above the 7/98 two-year New Zealand Government bonds.
The bonds have a coupon of eight percent and mature on October 15, 1998.
SBC Warburg said it was the first non-resident to issue fixed rate bonds in the New Zealand market.

It said the issue was at a better spread than any comparable security in the New Zealand market, and was launched in response to significant demand from New Zealand investors for high credit quality issues.
SBC Warburg New Zealand arranged and lead managed the issue.
